official_source: District of Columbia Board of Elections
limitations: Nonvoting delegate contest, not one of the 435 voting U.S. House districts. Keep the shadow United States Representative and Senator contests separate.
RCV-marked native published tallies; no independently verified round or final ranked-choice outcome.
Citywide JSON assigns REP to over/undervotes, but the native CSV leaves their party blank. Never count either as Republican candidate votes.
Delegate candidates plus over/undervotes are 324 below the separate total-ballots summary. Preserve the unexplained difference rather than inventing votes or treating candidate votes as turnout.
EarlyVotes is natively zero while ShowEarlyVotes is false. Do not infer that no early ballots were cast.
Native referenced 2019 precinct and 2022 ward maps are not approved 2026 geometry.
The seven complete official data/report originals are acquired, not a blanket license certification or a new approved normalized export.
